valid.active-warning.json: Active bounded presentation suppression over an exact warning evaluation.
valid.released-warning.json: Explicit release through a new immutable revision.
valid.expired-on-evaluation-change.json: Expiry after the bound evaluation changed.
valid.superseded-by-narrower-policy.json: Supersession by a distinct narrower suppression series.

invalid.active-with-resolution.json: Active suppression cannot contain terminal resolution.
invalid.fixed-expiry-without-timestamp.json: Fixed expiry requires an explicit timestamp.

nonimmediate-predecessor.json.description: A revision greater than one must identify the exact immediately preceding suppression revision.

resolution-prior-mismatch.json.description: Release, expiry, or supersession evidence must identify the same immediate prior revision as the envelope.

fixed-expiry-before-start.json.description: A fixed expiry timestamp must be later than suppression start.

self-supersession.json.description: A suppression series cannot supersede itself as its successor.
